record.paper_title: Orthogonality Types in Normed Linear Spaces
record.original_question: In a normed plane, let S_B denote the Joly curve built from positively oriented unit pairs u, v with u ⊥_B v, and let S_{P-} and S_{P+} denote the analogous Pythagorean-minus and Pythagorean-plus curves. Known equivalences use the orientation condition u ∧ v > 0: S_B = S_{P-} iff every such positively oriented Birkhoff-orthogonal unit pair also satisfies u ⊥_{P-} v, and similarly for S_{P+}. Can this orientation hypothesis u ∧ v > 0 be removed from those equivalences?

evidence.quote: Question 4.8.13 Can the condition u ∧ v > 0 be removed in the properties (i) and (ii)?

artifact.status_search_result: No published resolution of this specific question about removing the orientation hypothesis $u\wedge v>0$ from the Joly-curve equivalences relating Birkhoff and Pythagorean orthogonalities was located. The question is posed as an open problem and no follow-up work confirming or refuting it could be verified.
